description: Provision an AWS Apigatewayv2 Stage via the ACK apigatewayv2 controller. Fields mirror the apigatewayv2.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 Stage spec.

accessLogSettings.description: Settings for logging access in this stage.

format.description: A string with a length between [1-1024].

apiRef.description:
AWSResourceReferenceWrapper provides a wrapper around *AWSResourceReference
type to provide more user friendly syntax for references using 'from' field
Ex:
APIIDRef:

	from:
	  name: my-api

from.description:
AWSResourceReference provides all the values necessary to reference another
k8s resource for finding the identifier(Id/ARN/Name)

autoDeploy.description:
Specifies whether updates to an API automatically trigger a new deployment.
The default value is false.

clientCertificateID.description:
The identifier of a client certificate for a Stage. Supported only for WebSocket
APIs.

defaultRouteSettings.description: The default route settings for the stage.

deploymentID.description: The deployment identifier of the API stage.

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

additionalProperties.description: Represents a collection of route settings.

routeSettings.description: Route settings for the stage, by routeKey.

stageVariables.description:
A map that defines the stage variables for a Stage. Variable names can have
alphanumeric and underscore characters, and the values must match [A-Za-z0-9-._~:/?#&=,]+.
